svg.text: A BAD WEEK PREDICTS NOTHING ABOUT THE NEXT ONE
Every FBS team, weeks 1 and 2 of 2026. How far each finished from the betting line, in points.
Week 1: points better or worse than the line
Week 2: the same thing, seven days later
236 TEAMS. r = +0.06. THE CLOUD HAS NO TILT.
Last week explains three tenths of one percent of this week. Michigan went from nearly losing to Western Michigan to beating Oklahoma.
